_comment: #017 model: single-shot framewise BCE detector. Trunk identical to #007 (n_layers=8, d_model=384, n_mels=80, c_events=128). Head: Conv1D-on-bin-axis stack with per-bin audio features (upsampled from 125 future audio tokens to 500 bins), sinusoidal positional embedding (32-dim), broadcast cursor projection (32-dim). No diffusion machinery. ~21 M params (16.35 M trunk + ~5 M head).
